hypotheses.S0_label_coverage: At least 35 of 50 declared labels have 50 positive examples in each split.
hypotheses.S1_model_competence: At least 25 eligible labels have held-out AUROC at least 0.55 under the model's exact mean positive-versus-negative output-logit contrast.
hypotheses.S2_fixed_coalitions_recover_known_featur: Among competent labels, the median held-out AUROC of a discovery-selected 64-channel coalition is at least 0.70 in at least one layer.
hypotheses.S3_coalitions_beat_single_neurons: For competent labels, the best layer's median 64-channel AUROC exceeds its median single-neuron AUROC by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.S4_depth_adds_context: Layer 1's median 64-channel AUROC exceeds layer 0 by at least 0.02 on competent labels.
hypotheses.S5_neuron_aligned_ontology_is_sufficient: At least 75% of competent labels have a single native neuron within 0.03 AUROC of their layer-best 64-channel coalition.
hypotheses.S6_embedding_reinjection_control: The model-layer coalition exceeds a current-token unigram baseline by at least 0.03 median AUROC on competent labels.
hypotheses.S7_evaluation_is_held_out: Labels, examples, and coalition channels used for evaluation are disjoint from discovery examples, and all 50 labels were declared before activation collection.
